name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-snowflake-migrator
description: Investigate a Snowflake estate and migrate its structure onto Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP). Lists every table and view with exact row counts and column types; says which objects can and cannot be migrated with a brief reason for each; applies user-supplied restrictions; orders creation so views follow their base tables; and shallow-clones the structure into a Bronze layer that mirrors the source 1:1 - Snowflake database to AIDP Standard Catalog, schema to schema, table to table, view to view - with disabled Silver and Gold job stubs. Also maps warehouses to Spark cluster shapes with a sizing and credit proposal. Structure only: copies no data - every table arrives with zero rows. Ships a smoke test that verifies read on the source and read/write on the destination, and delivers the migration script as an executable AIDP notebook that prints per-object progress and verifies each object. Strictly read-only against Snowflake - the transport refuses any statement that is not a read, so nothing is ever written to or dropped from the source whatever the credential permits - dry-run by default against AIDP, executes through the aidp or oci CLI, and AIDP target coordinates are never stored - they are supplied per conversation and confirmed before any write. Every plan and summary also presents the six data-movement architecture options - internal/external catalogs, object storage, Fivetran/Kafka, Iceberg interop, a hybrid, or a customer-defined design that need not be any of them - with trade-offs, open unknowns and what each would take to build, so the architecture is chosen deliberately by the customer. A customer may also defer the choice entirely, which is recorded as a deliberate deferral rather than a gap. None is implemented in this version.
